en.headline: Driver arrested for drink-driving after Kwun Tong roundabout crash
en.dek: A motorcyclist was injured when a private car hit a motorcycle at the Lei Yue Mun Road and Kai Tin Road roundabout late on Sunday.
body: A 47-year-old private-car driver was arrested on suspicion of drink-driving after a collision with a motorcycle at a Kwun Tong roundabout late on Sunday, police said.

The crash happened at about 11.47pm at the junction of Lei Yue Mun Road and Kai Tin Road. Police said a motorcycle travelling towards Lam Tin and a private car travelling towards Yau Tong met at the roundabout, and the car struck the motorcycle. A 56-year-old motorcyclist suffered injuries to the hands and feet and was taken conscious to United Christian Hospital. A breath test on the motorcyclist returned a zero reading.

Officers said the private-car driver smelled of alcohol and failed a roadside breath test. He was arrested and later released on bail, pending a report to police in late September. Police said they were still investigating how the collision occurred.

zh.headline: 觀塘迴旋處私家車撞電單車 司機涉酒駕被捕
zh.dek: 週日近午夜，鯉魚門道與啟田道交界迴旋處兩車相撞，電單車司機手腳受傷送院，私家車司機酒精測試超標。
body: 警方表示，一名47歲私家車司機週日深夜在觀塘迴旋處與電單車相撞後，因涉嫌酒後駕駛被捕。
事發昨晚約11晈47分，鯉魚門道與啟田道交界迴旋處。警方指，電單車沿鯉魚門道往藍田方向行駛，私家車則往油塘方向，兩車在迴旋處碰撞。56歲電單車司機手腳受傷，清醒由救護車送往基督教聯合醫院治理，其酒精呼氣測試結果為零度。
警員調查期間發現私家車司機身上有酒氣，酒精呼氣測試超標，涉嫌酒後駕駛被捕，其後獲准保釋候查，須於9月下旬向警方報到。警方正調查意外原因。
